attributes.name: destgain
attributes.digest: Destination Gain
attributes.description: The gain applied to the samples in the region of the destination buffer over which the source is to be copied. The default value (0) will overwrite that section of the destination buffer, and a value of 1.0 would sum the source to the material that was present.

attributes.name: destination
attributes.digest: Destination Buffer
attributes.description: The name of the destination buffer.

attributes.name: deststartchan
attributes.digest: Destination Channel Offset
attributes.description: The channel offset in the destination buffer to start writing the source at. The destination buffer will be resized if the number of channels to copy is overflowing.

attributes.name: deststartframe
attributes.digest: Destination Offset
attributes.description: The time offset (in samples) in the destination buffer to start writing the source at. The destination buffer will be resized if the portion to copy is overflowing.
